Meet: Ester Nyamina // J127 Jewelry Participant.  Q1: Why do you want to be apart of James127 training? I am very poor and I a job to take care of my children. Q2: What work do you do now to help get money? I have been working for people digging small gardens. Q3: Tell us about your family. I was married, but my husband left and re-married. I live on my own with my two boys, Charles (2 ½) & Joseph (5). Q4. What would be your dream? To live a good life & be able to buy a house anywhere.
